generation_notes: VK-only revised batch combines vulnerability issue evidence, model internal protocol prior, and auditable built-in family constraints. No external protocol documents used. Four distinct issue-guided model-prior protocol sequences generated: vk-plan-033 (length_boundary_valid strategy for Diagnostics target_operation), vk-plan-034 (parser_depth strategy for Read File Record target_operation), vk-plan-035 (stateful_valid strategy for Read/Write Multiple Registers target_operation), vk-plan-036 (other strategy for Encapsulated Interface Transport target_operation). All findings fixed, family constraints enforced, safe issue analogues retained, exact payload collisions removed, real operation/frame/state diversity increased to 89. Each sequence uses conservative Modbus/TCP ADU with 7-byte MBAP header, protocol 0x0000, internally consistent lengths, varied unit/transaction identifiers, and model-prior field values.
